name: Gibeah
overview: Gibeah, a city associated with the tribe of Benjamin and also linked to Judah, is notably referenced as the city of Saul and a place marked by deep moral corruption, as seen in Hosea 9:9. The Scriptures recount the people's wickedness in Gibeah, leading to its destruction by the Israelites (Judges 19:12; Judges 20:31). Additionally, Gibeah is mentioned in the context of the ark of the covenant being conveyed there by the Philistines, and later the city is described as deserted (Isaiah 10:29; Joshua 15:57; Joshua 18:28). This history underscores the consequences of sin and the faithfulness of God’s judgment.
